title: Add shared-store and cross-platform handoff smoke coverage
description: Add storage integration coverage proving two projects configured with the same wtpDir observe the same global/task handoff collection, while legacy stores without handoffs.json initialize and read cleanly. Exercise write, get, claim attachment, purge, and export through the installed-style CLI process. Extend both Unix and PowerShell smoke scripts with a minimal handoff round trip using platform-safe quoting and cleanup.
